Title: Send default notification template
Preconditions: Admin signed in at {{BACK_URL}} with notification management permissions; VirtoCommerce.Notifications module installed and active; notification type 'OrderCreateEmailNotification' has a template for the default language; outbound mail transport configured for the environment
Steps:

[ACT] click the template row for the default language
[WAIT] the '...: Template' blade opens
[ACT] click 'Send test email' in the blade toolbar

[ACT] click 'Send'

[DOM] 'Send test email' in the blade toolbar is enabled while the template body is non-empty
[TOAST] a notification reports the send was accepted and no error dialog is present

Title: Store-scoped customization of a RETIRED invite type silently stops applying after the type swap
Preconditions: Admin token obtainable at {{BACK_URL}}; VirtoCommerce.Customer module is the PR #312 build or later. This is the disclosed breaking change: an integrator who customized RegistrationInvitationEmailNotification or RegistrationInvitationCustomerEmailNotification for a specific store loses that customization silently, because invites now dispatch the new types. No store-scoped customization of either retired type exists on this environment as of 2026-07-29, so the case CREATES one to make the gap reproducible
Steps:
[AUTH] obtain an admin token via POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/#!/workspace/notifications
[ACT] create a store-scoped custom template for RegistrationInvitationCustomerEmailNotification on a test store, with body text uniquely identifiable in a rendered preview
[ACT] trigger a new-user invite on that same store (see CUST-090)
[GRID] open the resulting notification from the activity feed
[ACT] open the Preview tab
Assertions:
[DOM] the notification actually sent uses the GLOBAL CustomerInviteNewUserEmailNotification template - the uniquely identifiable text from the store-scoped RegistrationInvitationCustomerEmailNotification override is ABSENT {SPEC} (vc-module-customer#312 swapped the dispatched type; the retired type is no longer raised, so its store override is orphaned)
[DOM] the orphaned store-scoped customization still EXISTS in the notification settings - it is silently unused, not deleted, so an integrator gets no signal {SPEC} (VCST-5281 upgrade notes: customization will no longer apply and emails silently fall back to the new defaults)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] GET the store-scoped customization for the retired type - it is still stored and retrievable
[API] the dispatched notification records one of the three NEW type names, not the retired one
Failure_Signals: The store customization IS applied, which would mean a compatibility shim exists and this case needs updating; no notification is sent at all; the retired customization is silently deleted by the upgrade rather than orphaned
Cleanup: [AUTH admin] delete the store-scoped customization created in Steps and the invite notification raised for the probe
